svg.title: ClipDeck — keyboard-first clipboard manager for Linux
svg.desc: Searchable clipboard history, CLI and native overlay. Real screenshots alternate between dark and light. ClipDeck v0.5.1 and Omarchy plugin v0.5.0.
svg.text: Persistent history. Full-text search. Automatic type detection.
Secret masking, Persian/RTL support, and a native overlay.
A Go daemon and CLI underneath. Your keyboard in control.
after downloading and inspecting the installer
